dictionary.lore:
An emerald stone embodying the virtue of endurance.

In a world of mostly warm-blooded creatures whose blood is a solid, sanguine red, how green came to represent health remains a mystery best left interpreted as "artistic liberty." Of course, poisonous man-eating insects would beg to differ.
